content:
**Filed the Brain UI epic #878 with seven slice tickets #879-#885; slice 1 linked to memory 2.0 (#864)**

**What**: Opened epic #878 (Brain UI) on 2026-09-08 following the #864 umbrella pattern (waves, exit, "what it must NOT become", brain-graph/1 block, track UI). Children: #879 slice 2 read model + `brain:snapshot --json` (no deps, first concrete work); #880 slice 1 review rounds as `type: review` records (needs 862, 805, 738; ships after #864 task 3.1a; drafts the memory-format promotion); #881 slice 3 local server + canvas + inspector (needs 879); #882 slice 4 management views (needs 881, 880); #883 slice 5 local overlay (needs 881); #884 slice 6 telemetry + MCP (needs 881, status:needs-review, RFC §8 q4 open); #885 slice 7 remote (needs 882, needs-review, RFC §8 q5 open). Epic and slices 1-5 labeled type:feature + status:approved per maintainer direction.

**Why**: Maintainer asked for a story for the UI with all slices as tickets, and that memory-related slices be linked to the memory story the other agent works. #851 was only the RFC and closed with PR #873.

**Where**: Bodies drafted in the session scratchpad; cross-link comment posted on #864 pointing at #880. Local design doc updated.

**Learned**: `gh issue create` needs `-R owner/repo` (or cwd inside the repo); a `cd` into the scratchpad made all eight creations fail cleanly before any side effect. Creating with `{{TOKEN}}` placeholders then `gh issue edit --body-file` after all numbers are known keeps brain-graph/1 blocks correct across a batch.
